kernels.detail: __syncthreads() is control-dependent on tid < ct1_size. The fuzz domains and RAPID2 physical launch can have ct1_size < blockDim.x, so only a subset of the block reaches the barrier and the target can deadlock independent of fuzzer validity.

evidence.note: __syncthreads() appears inside if (tid < ct1_size), creating a divergent barrier when ct1_size is smaller than the physical block.
